gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-liter: Metamorphous has generous space around every letter and strokes that taper only slightly, like a candle flame. Liter, by contrast, glows like neon tube at one line thickness, and its tall lowercase does the quiet reading work.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-michroma: Dramatic and slightly strange, Metamorphous shifts its weight gently along every curve. But Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, its open curves and tall lowercase doing the steady reading work.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-miriam-libre: Metamorphous gives every letter wide sidebearings and a measured thick-thin ratio. Miriam Libre draws its sans-serif letters with wire-like weight, and the tall lowercase and open s stay easy to follow paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans: Metamorphous leaves large sidebearings around every letter and keeps fat and slim strokes softly apart. Noto Sans lets its lowercase fill most of the letter height and leaves the c wide open, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Stately, with a gentle taper: Metamorphous narrows softly from stem to joint. And Noto Sans Avestan, with curve tips that stop short of touching and a pronounced x-height, makes extended reading go down easily.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-balines: Metamorphous keeps contrast restrained, just a small step between stem and connecting stroke. It earns its keep big and brief, while Noto Sans Balinese, with short ascenders and room inside every curve, handles the rest.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Metamorphous pinches slightly where its curves meet straight stems, with generous space around each letter. Yet the sharpest difference is the dominant midsection of Noto Sans Bassa Vah, which swallows the line's height.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-batak: Metamorphous shows its light modulation only up close, with large sidebearings around each letter. Noto Sans Batak sits underneath with a towering x-height and an e that never squeezes shut, so the two hold the page together.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-cheroke: Metamorphous uses in-between stroke contrast and large sidebearings, so each letter stands apart and gives the heading its commanding, distinctive presence. Noto Sans Cherokee handles the reading, tall with short stalks.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-ethiopi: Metamorphous keeps its stroke contrast tame, never razor thin, and surrounds each letter with generous space. Noto Sans Ethiopic, with a sturdy tall lowercase, carries long paragraphs without tiring.
